decided_from: Planform morphology names only, before loading any of our rows
rule_for_G1: Planform category = map(single morphology with largest frequency); ties -> set of mapped categories

Middle head, double head.reason: name includes double head; extra middle head ignored

Triple head.reason: more than two heads; not the bipolar double_head outcome

Quadruple head.reason: more than two heads; not the bipolar double_head outcome

Side head.reason: lateral ectopic head; not an AP-axis category

Double side heads.reason: lateral ectopic heads; not an AP-axis category

Middle head.reason: ectopic mid-body head; not an AP-axis category

Side protrusion.reason: lateral outgrowth; not an AP-axis category

Ectopic pharynxes, 2 posterior, ectopic.reason: ectopic organs; not one of the six named AP outcomes

Cyclop.reason: single fused-eye head; abnormal head, not normal and not headless

Pointed, fused eyes.reason: reduced head grade; abnormal head, not normal and not headless

Pointed, eyeless.reason: anophthalmic pointed head; a head is present, so not headless; abnormal so not normal
